resolved_discrepancies.description: "The price of retaining a positive lower curvature bound is the loss of second differentiability of the branches at the accumulation point" (lower_curvature.tex:11-13) reads as a statement about all branches. Only three of the four branches lose it: the first three branches f₀, f₁, f₂ of art:lower_objective, and the whitened branches f_i(Az) of Theorem art:local-failure-lower, are not twice differentiable at zero, where the bad starts accumulate; the fourth branch f₃(x) = μ‖x‖²/2 + x₂ is a quadratic, twice differentiable at every point, also after the fixed whitening (Lean witness). Theorem art:local-failure-lower states it correctly (negative_lower.tex:21-22: "The first three branches in this construction are not twice differentiable at zero"). Same wording issue as M8 (the abstract, A/master/prose/009, and verification.tex, A/verification/prose/017).
